info.title: 1lookup.dev API
info.summary: 96 data lookup products on one API key and one credit balance.
info.description:
Every product is POST https://api.1lookup.dev/v1/{product-slug} with a JSON body and the header "Authorization: Bearer <key>".

Live keys start with 1lk_live_ and spend credits; test keys start with 1lk_test_, return each product's sample response and spend nothing.

Every response uses the same envelope: success, data (the result) or error (code and message), and meta (credits used and remaining, cache state, request id, latency).

Failed requests are not charged, nor are repeats of the same input within 7 days. Bulk CSV jobs and webhooks are described in the guides at https://1lookup.dev/docs.
